subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw accept chat-side `/close`/`/delete` and native `/new` naming now, or wait until the session title contract work settles?
rationale: This adds a new destructive chat command surface and overlaps the active session title migration, so code correctness alone does not settle the product boundary.

options.title: Fix and continue
options.body: Require the parser fix, main conflict resolution, current-head proof, and then review the destructive command UX as part of this PR.

options.title: Pause for title contract
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95182 settles the canonical title/label contract, then rebase and narrow the command behavior.

options.title: Decline chat deletion
options.body: Keep naming follow-ups but reject `/close` and `/delete` from chat if maintainers do not want destructive session operations in channel commands.

recommendation.title: Fix and continue
recommendation.body: Require the parser fix, main conflict resolution, current-head proof, and then review the destructive command UX as part of this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main history points to Peter on the central command files, and the decision spans command UX plus session-state boundaries.
